description: The file is a C header file (.h) for the host interface JSON request handler in a TR-069 device host interface project. It declares APIs for handling JSON messages over HTTP, such as starting/stopping the HTTP server, handling messages, and parsing/creating JSON payloads.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server for JSON request handling.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP JSON messages, extracting the JSON payload and passing it to the common API.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server for JSON request processing.
